body: Can you please provide a sample project that exhibits this behavior?
I do not know myself yet how the error comes about and therefore do not know how to build a reproducer. My hope was that we can look at the problem together here.
Is there a way to log all requests and responses?
Thank you. Looks like the error happens before the request/response is logged because nothing is output. But with another (working) request everything is logged.
Understood. I think we'll still need a reproducer though... Without it, we're basically shooting in the dark

Did it: https://github.com/andlinger/quarkus-reproducer/tree/quarkus-24364
Please note that `io.i15s.quarkus.HttpClient/mp-rest/url` in `application.properties` points to a port that is not open.

A call to `http://localhost:8080/product` should throw the described exception.

issue.title: Ensure that connection issues can be handled in Reactive REST Client
